desc: The Hornady M2 Digital Bench Powder Scale is made from the same high quality, precision load cell found on the Hornady Auto Charge. The high performance Bench Scale is the perfect addition to your reloading bench. With a capacity of 1500 grains, you can weigh powder, bullets, cases, cartridges and more. The large LCD display is easy to read and weighs precisely to a tenth (0.1) of a grain. Included are two calibration weights, AC adaptor, 220V adaptor, and metal powder pan.
